responsibility: Declares the loop trip-count and execution-estimate query interface used by tree loop optimizers. The header exposes APIs to simplify operations using initial loop conditions, analyze a specific exit, compute or estimate exact/max/likely iteration and statement-execution counts, test wraparound assumptions, rewrite cached loop-info expressions, and free iteration metadata when transformations invalidate it.
same_name_distinction: Declares the query and maintenance interface for loop-iteration analysis—APIs for exit analysis, exact/max/likely estimates, wrap checks, simplification, and invalidation. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-loop-niter.cc, it provides declarations only, not the trip-count inference implementation.
